page: Microsoft Azure F32ads_v7 is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance running on Microsoft Hyper-V. The system is powered by an AMD EPYC 9V45 x86_64 processor clocked at up to 4.5 GHz, delivering 32 dedicated physical cores across 32 vCPUs with one thread per core. Memory capacity measures 128.0 GB of RAM, equating to 4.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware cache provisions include 48 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache. Modern vector and instruction extensions are available, including AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, and AVX-512 BF16. There are no GPUs present on this instance type.

Integrated local storage is a primary feature of the F32ads_v7 architecture, bundling a 3780 GB NVMe SSD directly on the host. In benchmark evaluations, the dedicated AMD processor achieves top-tier results in single-core stress testing (3541.18 stress-ng score) and single-threaded data compression (38.0 GB/sec in gzip). Multi-core throughput exhibits strong placement in stress-ng (111314.11) and PassMark CPU metrics (72176.91). Database operations on PassMark register in the top 10% tier at 37385.95, while Redis SET throughput achieves 89.24 million operations per second, supported by 214.06 GB/sec in uncached read bandwidth.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the inclusion of 3.78 TB of fast local NVMe SSD alongside a dedicated 32-core AMD platform eliminates the necessity for external disk attachments for temporary scratch storage or local caching layers. While lacking hardware accelerators such as GPUs or AMX matrix units, the system offers high CPU frequency and strong vector support, reaching 4183.35 tokens per second for small language model prompt processing.

The F32ads_v7 server is optimal for compute-bound and I/O-intensive workloads requiring rapid local disk access. Best-fit applications include relational and key-value database operations, batch compression pipelines, high-throughput web serving, and continuous integration compilation tasks.
description: Microsoft Azure F32ads_v7 is a compute-optimized instance equipped with 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs from an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor running at up to 4.5 GHz. The configuration features 128.0 GB of system RAM, providing 4.0 GB per core, and incorporates 3780 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage. The x86_64 architecture incorporates AVX-512 extensions, including VNNI and BF16 instructions, with zero GPUs present. In benchmarks, the F32ads_v7 demonstrates top-tier single-core performance alongside strong multi-core processing, top-tier database operation scores, and high compression rates. Memory throughput reaches 214.06 GB/sec for uncached block reads, matching well with the bundled NVMe disk to deliver cost-efficient local storage density without requiring separate block storage devices. This instance is well configured for relational databases, Redis caching layers, web serving, batch data processing, and enterprise CI/CD compilation workloads.
